family.description: Exploratory pilot of the integrated matched-algorithm comparison of gf2's production LDPC batch decode with AFF3CT [Cassagne2019] at the pin of c077a88b. The baseline arm is the gf2-coding LdpcBatchDecoder of default construction under the committed coding envelope, which installs that envelope's decode selectors and worker-aware routing, so every wave takes the production route those selectors choose; it is a native build of the story's arms workspace. The candidate arm is AFF3CT's flooding f32 normalized min-sum decoder, the pinned external executable, one clone per pinned worker. Both are launched by the executable digests of the live build identity records of the arms catalogue, build-identity.json. The matched-algorithm settings both arms share are the parity-check matrix of the recorded AList (decoder.code.h_sha256), the recorded LLRs (decoder.input.llr_sha256), f32 precision, the flooding schedule, normalized min-sum at the declared factor, the iteration cap and syndrome stopping, with AFF3CT's syndrome check at depth one; P-19 compares each arm's reported settings with that declaration, and decoder.batching.batch_size is the per-frame decode both prepared quality records hold. The measured operation is the steady-state decode of 3be770d5: every worker is a thread pinned to one resolved CPU and owns one decoder built before timing, and a timed call makes every worker decode the cell's per-worker batch, workload.size.timed_batch, of the first recorded frames, including LLR conversion, dispatch and extraction of the information-window decisions. Per code, the cells are a single-worker full-wave throughput cell, a single-frame latency cell and a twelve-physical-core throughput cell whose CPU identities the runner resolves at run time through host::resolve_core_arm. Every timed execution checks each worker's per-frame bit errors against the arm's prepared c077a88b quality record. The fastest quality-compatible comparison is outside this family: its pilot admitted no AFF3CT mode as quality-compatible (findings.md). No nested pool is declared. The family's fresh ledger admits six confirmatory cells on its first attempt under P-20, the cell count declared here. This family publishes the matched comparison and selects nothing. This pilot observes the measurement resolution that the family's confirmation freezes; it decides nothing.

effect.rationale: The family publishes the matched comparator gap with AFF3CT [Cassagne2019] and adopts nothing, so it declares no worthwhile speedup.
effect.equivalence_rationale: Within ten percent at matched settings, a receiver choosing between gf2's production route and AFF3CT [Cassagne2019] gains too little throughput to repay integrating and maintaining a second decoder dependency, so the family reads the arms as equivalent. Fixed before this pilot; the canonical freezer stops when pilot resolution reaches it and never widens it from results.
effect.material_gap_rationale: A steady-state gap of a quarter of a receiver's decode throughput at matched settings outweighs the integration and maintenance cost of a second decoder dependency, so it changes which decoder a receiver deploys and needs attribution; it lies outside the equivalence margin. Fixed before this pilot; the canonical freezer stops when pilot resolution reaches it and never widens it from results.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: The family selects nothing and adds no production code.
